title: Set up your dev environment in Ecwid | Ecwid Documentation
snippet:
The first step is to get yourself a store. Only stores on paid plans can access API. If you don’t yet have a store, [sign up with Ecwid](https://my.ecwid.com/cp/?partner=ecwid_3partydevs).
Ecwid provides a **free upgrade to a paid plan** if you:
[Email us](/contact-ecwid-api-support-team#email-support) to get a free plan upgrade for your test store.

title: Ecwid
snippet:
CostA paid Ecwid plan (the free plan is excluded; Ecwid does not publish a per-tier API mapping, so check the current plan page before committing). Ecwid grants a free upgrade to a paid plan for developers building a store customization, an integration for a working store, a public App Market app, or Instant Site templates - you email API Support to request it. Creating the custom app and its tokens is free.

Where to apply: No form for the API itself - upgrade the store in the Ecwid admin (or email API Support for the free developer upgrade if you qualify). Then open the app dashboard at my.ecwid.com/#develop-apps and copy the secret token from the custom app's Details page.

Stored encrypted; used server-side only. Note: the Ecwid REST API requires a paid Ecwid plan.Encrypted with AES-256-GCM on save and never shown again.

The Develop apps page offers no API access
Why: The store is on the Free plan.
Fix: Upgrade to any paid Ecwid plan, then reopen the app dashboard.
